name: Blackout - Darkens the screen except for the speech and Braille viewer
author: BFW Würzburg
description: demonstrates the information NVDA users receive, while ensuring that sighted people are not distracted by the rest of the screen. With NVDA+Alt+b the entire screen is completely darkened. - If the Speech Viewer is active, it stays visible. If it is not active, it will be automatically opened. - The Braille Viewer can be manually activated and will then also be displayed.
